SUBMISSION_STATUS: BUILT AND GATED, NOT SUBMITTED -- a new design axis (a different code distance); not submitted when this build record was written
motivation: the d=5 logical test had 1-6 failures per arm in 131,072 shots and no power; a d=3 memory fails often enough for a logical effect to be measurable
operating_point_note: g=288 ns declared is the CENTRE of the qualified seven-gap basin, 620 ns true separation, 5.0 % cycle overhead

gate_hierarchy.D0: mechanism premise at g=0: theta_b(0) < 0 AND theta_a(0) > 0 under a pre-specified magnitude criterion. The d=3 geometry changes the local syndrome-extraction context and the phenomenon cannot be assumed to survive.
gate_hierarchy.D1: detector-level control at the mitigation gap, AND the RETURNED causal separation must lie inside the qualified basin, 428-1068 ns true.
gate_hierarchy.D2: logical consequence, interpreted ONLY if D0 and D1 both pass. If D0 fails a logical difference is a gap or duration effect in a different circuit and would look exactly like a logical consequence.

power_note: at 393,216 shots/arm a rate of 1e-3 gives ~393 failures and a 20 % change near the designed resolution; a rate of 1e-4 gives ~39 failures and an 80 %-power detectable ratio nearer 1.75 than 1.20
